'''Dorri Canas''' was a middle-aged [[Gender/Legends|woman]] from [[Iritsa]] who was very concerned about the relations between the [[Clog-dweller]]s and [[Stones-dweller|Stone-dwellers]]. She wore a long robe favored by [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] and was very critical of [[Jorga Sune]].
